descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]的卫星上有异动。

初步扫描显示一些古代科技已经被启动，或许是对我们的殖民行为作出的反应。

我们的几个顶级科学家非常想去调查一下这个卫星，并为此准备好了一项特殊研究项目。
descriptions.en:
Something stirs on the moon of [Root.GetName].

Preliminary scans indicate that some ancient technology has become active, possibly as a response to our colonization efforts.

Several of our top scientists are eager to take a closer look at the moon, and have prepared a special research project.

descriptions.zh:
这当然是一群难以控制的无人机。

无人机对我们的错误敌我识别令早先的失望一扫而空——它们把我们当成已经逝去的主人的种群！见到我们似乎让他们很激动——如果这么老的人工智能有“激动”这种功能的话。但不幸的是，这些无人机很快就再次进入了休眠状态，我们也无法重新唤醒它们。

这样的话，不如拆开来看看吧。
descriptions.en:
It is a gaggle of wayward drones, of course.

Initial disappointment was swept away by the drones' erroneous IFF classification of us - they think we are a race affiliated with their long-dead masters! They seemed very excited, if old AI constructs can be excited, to see us. Unfortunately, the drones again lapsed into inactivity shortly after and we have been unable to resuscitate them.

Or take them apart, for that matter.

label.en: Keep an eye on the situation.

descriptions.zh: 这些无人机从休眠中苏醒，并来到了[Root.GetName]的地表。它们礼貌的拒绝了我们的友好沟通，并开始将行星上的一小片地区环境改造。我们不清楚他们这种行为有何目的，但对殖民地似乎是无害的。
descriptions.en: The drones woke from their slumber and descended to the surface of [Root.GetName]. Attempts to communicate were met with polite dismissal as they set about terraforming a small area of the planet. We do not know the nature of whatever ancient directive they are executing, but it does not seem detrimental to the colony.

label.zh: 呃，只要他们的行为能对我们有益就好……
label.en: Well, as long as their activities benefit us...

tooltips.en: The drones remove a random £blocker£ §YTile Blocker§! from the surface, leaving the planet otherwise untouched.

titles.zh: 古老无人机：到达过去的天空
titles.en: Ancient Drones: Reaching For Past Skies

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]卫星上陆陆续续有休眠的无人机再苏醒过来，它们做的事情也让人喜忧参半。

在天上无数监视器的监视下，它们在夜色中于我们在[Root.GetName]上的主要殖民地外不远处建立起了一个巨大建筑的初步架构。工程师认为这是叫做“太空电梯”的过时产物，或许在我们[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]进入星际旅行之前的那个时代很常见。最终我们还是要摧毁它，因为它阻碍了殖民地的发展，不过安全的摧毁它还是需要花些时间。我们的工程师正好想近距离研究一下这个东西。
descriptions.en:
The old drones fitfully dormant on [Root.GetName]'s moon have become active again, and their work is a mixed blessing.

Under the cover of night and spotty airspace surveillance, they have erected the framework of some gigantic structure a short distance away from our primary settlement on [Root.GetName]. Our engineers are convinced it is the realization of some outmoded concept known as a "space elevator," perhaps a common sight in the times before we [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] first took to the stars. It will eventually have to be razed as it stands in the way of our expansion plans for the colony, and bringing it down safely will take some time. At least our engineers are giddy with excitement at the prospect of studying the thing up close.

descriptions.zh:
再次苏醒之后，这些无人机暂时在传感器上消失了。回来的时候，它们拖着一大箱不知从什么地方运来的矿物。在发出一个损坏严重的猝发传输信号表明他们已经完成了指定任务后，它们就把这些矿物丢在了[Root.GetName]的地表。

之后它们就回到了月球上。
descriptions.en:
After waking yet again, the drones briefly disappeared from sensors. When they returned, it was with a large cache of minerals of unknown origin in tow. They dumped it on the surface of [Root.GetName] after sending a badly corrupted burst transmission indicating that they had fulfilled a requisition request.

Then they went back to the moon.

label.zh: 免费的矿物，这种好事不常有。

descriptions.zh: 卫星上的信号激增提醒我们[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的无人机已再次苏醒。这次它给我们带来了一个好东西：深层出土的古老卫星。并且它们已经对其进行了一定程度的整修。我们不清楚卫星是怎么跑到这里来的，也不知道无人机为什么到现在才把它挖出来。尽管如此，即使它的数据库里只有一小部分保存了下来，也足够我们了解这些无人机的主人曾经所在的帝国的日常生活情况了。
descriptions.en: Frantic signal bursts from the moon alerted us to the fact that the old drones on [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have woken yet again. This time they bring us a significant prize, as they have unearthed an ancient satellite from the depths of their moon and partially repaired it. We do not know how the satellite ended up there, nor why the drones have ignored it until now. Regardless, if even a fragment of its databanks have survived, there is a lot we can learn about day-to-day life in the empires that the drones first served.

titles.zh: 古代无人机：无人机的崩溃

descriptions.zh:
一直沉睡的无人机发生了巨大转变，不再做不规则运动。一部分苏醒了过来，像往常一样进入[Root.GetName]的大气中，却一头全速撞向了行星的地面。

相同的情况一直在发生。

殖民地没有受到多大损失，但这些脆弱无比的无人机却变成了一团团闪着蓝色火花的废铁，好像在诉说着它们自我毁灭的决心和力量。
descriptions.en:
The erratic behavior of the narcoleptic drones have taken a violent turn. A number of them woke and entered the atmosphere of [Root.GetName], as is their wont, only to slam into the surface of the planet at full thrust.

Repeatedly, in many cases.

Damage to the colony was negligible but the nigh-invulnerable drones were destroyed in bright showers of blue sparks, indicative of the tremendous force of, and dedication to, their self-destruction.

label.zh: 我们能搞清楚它们到底是怎么了吗？
label.en: Can we find out what was wrong with them?

descriptions.zh:
自毁事件之后，剩余的无人机就消失了。[Root.GetName]的历史学家认为它们仍徘徊在附近，在某些失落科技的保护下隐蔽不见，但它们并没与在本应苏醒的时间苏醒过来。

对自毁无人机遗迹的深度分析进展缓慢，但应该马上就会有突破了。
descriptions.en:
The surviving drones have been missing since the suicide incident. History buffs on [Root.GetName] are convinced the drones are still in close proximity, shielded from view by some lost technology, but the expected time window for their next activation has come and gone.

Progress on deep analysis of the destroyed drones' remains has been slow, but a breakthrough is expected soon.

descriptions.zh: 从破碎的无人机内部找寻故障所花费的时间比预计的长得多，因为每个无人机的内部结构和组装部件都不尽相同。知晓了这一点，那当务之急就是要找出相同的部件。单独来看这些部件的话，如果是外星人制作的，那肯定是现代的东西。如此就很可能是有人做了我们做不到的事情，篡改了这些无人机。
descriptions.en: Sorting out the errant innards of the shattered drones took much longer than anticipated, as each drone seems to have been built from a slightly different design, assembled from slightly different parts. Once this fact was established, one thing stood out - the parts that were identical. Separated from the rest, it is clear these parts are of somewhat modern, if alien, make. It is likely that someone has done what we could not, and tampered with the drones.

label.zh: 这需要我们进行深入调查。

titles.en: Ancient Drones: Alien to the Aliens

descriptions.zh: 将它们组装起来之后，我们的专家认为这些无人机残骸内部的外星部件是单向通讯设备。它们并未处在接收状态，所以我们可以推断出这些无人机不是在第三方的指令下进行活动，而是有什么个体一直在监视这些无人机的活动。建议对此事进行进一步调查。
descriptions.en: Having pieced them together, the foreign objects inside the destroyed drones have been identified by our experts as one-way transmitters. Since they are not set to receive, it is safe to assume that the drones were not acting at the behest of some third party. Rather, some entity has been keeping tabs on the drones' activities. It is advisable to look into this matter.

titles.zh: 古老无人机：上天的回答

descriptions.zh:
我们找到了剩下的无人机，它们漂浮在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道上。

我们已经了解到它们只是某些派系周密计划里的小喽啰。根据我们了解的类似行动的掌握，这个派系很可能是某个特别古老而智慧的海盗集团。他们比我们先发现了这些无人机，做了我们做不到的事情，改装了这些无人机。虽然听起来没那么厉害—他们做的只是将单独的外星科技放进无人机里，但是这些外星海盗的科技水平比我们高出许多，至少在某些领域是这样。安装完毕之后，这些海盗将它们放回太空，他们知道这些无人机的目的是为了帮助原主人建设殖民地，而随着时间的流逝，这些无人机鉴别主人的能力正在减弱。无人机一直在帮我们建设殖民地，而海盗一直在监视，一直在等待发动攻击的好时机。

我们的战斗分析员预测这些海盗会在两年之内发起攻击。
descriptions.en:
We have found the remaining drones, drifting into orbit around [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. We have learned that they are unwitting pawns in an elaborate scheme set up by an unknown faction.

Going by the modus operandi of this operation, this faction is most likely a particularly old and particularly clever pirate syndicate. They must have found the drones drifting through space and done what we could not; modified them. While not as impressive as it sounds - all they did was introduce self-contained alien technology into the drones - fact remains that these alien pirates possess a technological know-how far in advance of our own, at least in certain areas. Having installed their comms devices in the drones, the pirates let them drift through space again, knowing that they are set to assist their original masters' colonists and that the drones' ability to accurately identify such colonists has degraded with age. The drones have essentially been fattening up our colony as the pirates watch, waiting for the ideal time to strike.

Our military analysts predict that the pirates will strike within the next two years.

label.zh: 夺取无人机，用它们毁灭它们将来的主人。
label.en: Capture the drones, send them to destroy their would-be masters.

descriptions.zh: 我们夺取了无人机，在其中装满了高爆炸药。我们知道了如何拆解，对它们进行重新设置就没那么难了，我们在海盗舰队可能会经过的位置给他们准备了一份大餐。顶级[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]科学家们植入了我们的敌我识别技术来把误伤平民的几率降到最低。
descriptions.en: We have captured the drones and fitted them with explosive charges. Reprogramming them proved to be a relatively easy task now that we know how to break them open, and we have plotted a course for the estimated location of the pirate fleet. Top [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] scientists have implemented our own IFF technology to minimize the risk of the drones attacking innocents.

descriptions.en: The pirate fleet has arrived, somewhat later than expected. Judging by the makeup of the fleet and formations used, they have rallied their allies in an effort to pillage and burn [Root.GetName] as quickly and decisively as possible.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]建立了殖民地，当地的一些植物在释放大量含有复杂化学成分的花粉。

为此准备了一项特别研究计划，来研究这种植物。
descriptions.en:
Several plants native to [Root.GetName], where we recently established a colony, exude copious amounts of a pollen with an astounding chemical complexity.

A special research project has been prepared for further study of this flora.

descriptions.zh: 长期暴露在[Root.GetName]大气中的花粉会对信息素受体产生轻微催情效果，随之而来的是一种不易察觉的“兴奋”。而效果最强的植物在这颗星球各处都很常见；被[Root.GetName]的科学家储存在了一个隐蔽的地方，在[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]当地语言中被称为“玛琳·卡琳”。
descriptions.en: Long-term exposure to the pollen naturally occurring in [Root.GetName]'s atmosphere acts on the colonists' pheromone receptors with a mild aphrodisiac effect, accompanied by a barely-perceptible "high." The plant that produces the most potent strain is a flower common to all areas of the planet; squirreled away into some obscure taxonomic nook by scientists on [Root.GetName] but known in the local [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] dialect as "Mharin Kharin."

label.zh: 我们不能让这种影响心智的东西留在大气中。
label.en: We cannot allow mind-altering particles in the atmosphere.

label.zh: 我们能彻底消灭这种植物的手段。
label.en: We do not have the resources to exterminate the plant.

titles.zh: 玛琳·卡琳：准备应付花朵
titles.en: Mharin Kharin: Making Time for Petals

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]的报告显示最近的工作效率开始下降，在比[Root.Owner.GetName]的平均值低好几个百分点的地方稳定下来。

这有可能是由星球上的刺激性花粉造成的。

很可能是。

已发起§Y特殊项目§!来进一步，以期提高生产线效率来弥补损失。
descriptions.en:
Reports from [Root.GetName] indicate that worker productivity has declined recently, becoming stable at levels several percent lower than the [Root.Owner.GetName] average.

This may or may not be due to the stimulating effects of the pollen native to the planet.

It probably is.

A §YSpecial Project§! has been prepared should we wish to make our production pipelines more efficient to make up for the loss.

label.en: Let's see what can be done.

descriptions.zh:
通过对[Root.GetName]上的时间管理模型进行深刻革命，并对所有生产领域的责任和各项职责进行重新分配，我们收到了良好的效果。大众的要求显而易见，而外界观察者会将其称作公开需求，那就是要与当地的植物群落保持紧密的联系。

可是即使运用合理的时间分配和额外的即时检查，生产效率仍旧很低，只是至少已经脱离了不可接受的最低水平。
descriptions.en:
Far-reaching changes to time management paradigms and the way responsibility is delegated within all fields of production and other duties on [Root.GetName] have produced good results. The populace has an evident desire - outside observers would call it an outright need - to be in close proximity to the native flora.

With clever scheduling and additional checks in place, productivity remains low but has risen above the lower limit of what can be deemed acceptable.

descriptions.zh:
最近的调查报告显示，[Root.GetName]上的居民比[Root.Owner.GetName]的其他居民更不愿意迁移到其他殖民地。

玛琳·卡琳和它的近亲植物会造成一种轻度的心理上的感知依赖。但是调查报告中并没有指明两件事情之间有任何关联。
descriptions.en:
A recent survey indicates that residents of [Root.GetName] are much less likely than other denizens of the [Root.Owner.GetName] to migrate to other colonies.

The survey does not address whether this could be due to a psychological dependency on the low-level sensory arousal caused by Mharin Kharin and its sibling-plants.

descriptions.zh: 尽管星球上的生产力不再下降了，[Root.GetName]上殖民城市和[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上首府之间的通信却开始崩溃。[Root.GetName]上的高级官员之间开始变得越来越冷淡，我们的办事员不断抱怨说即使只是发送一个简单的指令现在都变成了一件困难重重的事。
descriptions.en: While productivity is no longer declining on the planet, communications between the colony on [Root.GetName] and the capital on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] are breaking down. Senior officials on [Root.GetName] are growing increasingly distant, and our clerks are complaining that even relaying simple directives is becoming an exercise in frustration.

descriptions.zh: 我们送去[Root.GetName]处理问题的行政小队好像背叛了。幸运的是，他们的计划起到的作用简直是微乎其微。他们的计划进行得极慢，一下子就被我们发现了，真是一点都不令人感到惊奇。风水轮流转——这只是个比喻而已——我们最后的手段就是废除当地的政府，然后直接从首府那里管理殖民地的事务。
descriptions.en: It appears that the crack team of administrators we sent to [Root.GetName] in order to set things straight have been turned. Fortunately for us, their plot to do as little work as possible was, unsurprisingly, sloppily executed and easily discovered. Heads will roll - metaphorically speaking of course - as our last recourse is to depose the local government and manage the colony's affairs from the capital.

titles.en: Mharin Kharin: With an Iron Fist, From Afar

descriptions.zh: 我们的从属政策已经在[Root.GetName]上根深蒂固了。它成功地控制了花粉植物玛琳·卡琳的繁殖。它还成功减少了人们对“使用”这种植物的接受度——这成就可不小，因为这种行为和闻闻花香一样没什么可指摘的。
descriptions.en: Our remote-government of [Root.GetName] is now firmly established. It has met with some success in suppressing the proliferation of the pollen-bearing plant Mharin Kharin as well as in eroding the community's acceptance of "using" it - no small feat considering the act is as innocent as smelling a flower.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上面的从属治理一直在进行着生硬而卓有成效的管理。据说掌控大权的国会——显然他们更喜欢躲在房间里呼吸玛琳·卡琳的花粉——已经控制了我们安排在星球上面的一支军团。从属治理希望用这些部队对那些花发起一次进攻，让他们安装一些大气过滤机，并把这种植物从市区完全抹除。
descriptions.en: Our remote-governance of [Root.GetName] continues to be a somewhat awkward but effective arrangement. The council in charge has allegedly secured the loyalty of a faction of our armed forces on the planet - apparently they prefer staying indoors to breathing in the Mharin Kharin pollen. The remote-government wishes to use these troops to mount an offensive on the flower, having them erect atmospheric purifiers and wiping the plant from all urban areas entirely.

label.en: We should have done this a long time ago.

Their leader, a self-styled "Green Hierophant" of this "Flower Temple" claims to speak for all flora and fauna of [Root.GetName] and demands exclusive trading rights for the plant.

This is of course completely unacceptable and impossible, as the native flora of [Root.GetName] is of little strategic or economic value and thus may not be brought off-world by law.

Unfortunately, they are unlikely to accept this fact gracefully.

descriptions.zh:
圣花宫殿和它的追随者们的人数现在在[Root.GetName]的总人口中占了不小的比例。报告显示，他们组织的运动出现了一些可疑的改变。他们越来越不热心于走私玛琳·卡琳。圣花宫殿似乎逐渐转变成了一种相信世界末日的宗教事务。大气检测器发现玛琳·卡琳的花粉近期出现了一些变化，也许此事和圣花宫殿的改变有关联。

已发起§Y特殊项目§!来评估此事可能会带来的风险。建议在可能的灾难发生前完成这个项目。
descriptions.en:
The Flower Temple and its followers now make up a sizable minority of the population on [Root.GetName], and reports indicate a disturbing change in the movement. Their futile attempts to smuggle Mharin Kharin specimen off-world have been growing less enthusiastic by the day, as the Flower Temple seems to be transitioning into a doomsday cult. There is likely a correlation with the recent changes in the Mharin Kharin pollen's chemical makeup, detected by atmospheric sensors.

A §YSpecial Project§! has been prepared to assess the risks associated with this, and it is recommended to complete it before something goes horribly wrong.

descriptions.zh:
坚决而迅速的反制措施使我们迅速发现了[Root.GetName]上原生花朵的花粉变化所带来的危险。我们迅速采取了必要措施。

我们彻底疏散了星球上的人群，并且针对玛琳·卡琳及其近亲植物进行了多轮战术性除草轰炸。

这些植物很快就变得对除草剂免疫了。如果这些花粉没有被清除的话，它们就会开始散发一种神经剧毒。所有拥有嗅觉器官的[Root.GetName]生物都会受到致命威胁。

殖民议会的科学家认为这是[Root.GetName]上的一种自然循环。虽然花粉会对我们产生种种不良影响：使我们的当地管理瘫痪，引导圣花骑士教团建立，甚至最终产生剧毒。但是这其实只是偶然的副作用，而不是植物为了自卫而设计的阴谋诡计。

如今，星球的表面上如今已经见不到这些花的踪迹了。我们的殖民地居民们也得到了安全保障，再也不用受到花粉的威胁了。
descriptions.en:
Quick and decisive action allowed us to identify the risks associated with the rapid changes in the pollen native to [Root.GetName] and take the necessary steps.

The necessary steps were a complete planetary evacuation and a planet-wide tactical pesticide bombing run, targeting the Mharin Kharin flower and its ilk.

The plants were rapidly mutating and their unique pollen would, had they not been destroyed, soon have begun delivering a potent neurotoxin to the olfactory organs of all sapient life on [Root.GetName].

The scientists on the colonization council theorize that this is part of a natural cycle on [Root.GetName] and that the pollen's adverse effects on us, in the form of a crumbling local administration, the rise of the Flower Temple cult, and eventual pollen toxicity, were chance side-effects rather than the product of a plant's sinister self-defense mechanism.

Regardless, any and all traces of the flower have been wiped from the planet's surface, and our colonists are safe and free of the pollen's influence.

tooltips.en: The planet has been purged of the dangerous flower, removing all related modifiers.

titles.en: Mharin Kharin: The Pollen's End of Us

descriptions.zh:
灾难降临了。

无数的玛琳·卡琳开始自发地进行变异，就像野火那样一发不可收拾地蔓延开来。它们的花粉开始变得剧毒，我们已经束手无策了。

因为我们发现的太晚，我们没能撤离星球上的居民，中和花粉的尝试也以失败告终。[Root.GetName]上的居民遭受了灭顶之灾。

[Root.GetName]上的植物获得了胜利，但是它们也将付出代价，尽管这件事对我们来说只是一种毫无意义的安慰。玛琳·卡琳所属的种群由于过度繁殖，导致土壤中缺少它所需要的某种营养物质——很快，这些植物就会死亡。要经过非常长得一段时间以后，这些植物才能重新在生态系统中找到自己的落脚点。谁知道它们到底会不会找到。

[Root.GetName]的居民都丧生了。星球的大气由于植物排放的气体而暂时变得有毒。
descriptions.en:
Something went horribly wrong.

Vast swaths of Mharin Kharin flowers spontaneously mutated in unison, spreading like wildfire and turning their pollen poisonous, and we were too late.

Both our evacuation efforts and our attempts to neutralize the pollen fell short of the mark and the inhabitants of [Root.GetName] paid the price.

The plant life of [Root.GetName] achieved only a pyrrhic victory, though this fact is scant consolation. The whole genus that Mharin Kharin belonged to burned in the fire of its own unnaturally rapid proliferation. The soil is starved of the specific nutrients the pollinating plants need - once the currently living specimens die, which will be soon, it will be a long time before that flora can again establish a foothold in the ecosystem, if it ever will.

The inhabitants of [Root.GetName] are dead, and the planet's atmosphere is temporarily noxious with plant emissions.

label.zh: 我们不会忘却这场悲剧的。
label.en: We will not forget this tragedy.

两年也许不足以令我们遗忘[Root.Owner.GetName]曾经居住的那些人所遭遇的悲剧，但是至少现在这颗行星对智慧生命不再抱有敌意了。

A planetary surveillance team reports that the toxic miasma that enveloped a planet two years ago and led to the destruction of our colony has lifted. The planet is different now, changed into a desert world after the violent blooming of Mharin Kharin and the atmosphere becoming saturated with pollen.

It will take more than these two years for the [Root.Owner.GetName] to forget the tragic fate of those who lived there, but the planet itself is no longer actively hostile to sapient life.

descriptions.zh: 由于重大的记录错误，[Root.GetName]部分区域的基础设施维护与住宅服务已趋于落后。人们正居住在较为恶劣的环境之中，似乎已忍不了太久了。要修复这些问题则会耗费我们的时间与精力。
descriptions.en: Due to a major clerical error parts of [Root.GetName] has fallen behind in infrastructure maintenance and accommodation services. The people live in rather bleak conditions and will not tolerate it for long. Remedying these problems will cost us time and effort.

label.zh: 我们必须对此区域进行投资。
label.en: We must invest in this area.

label.zh: 我们有强大的团队，帮助他们复原。
label.en: We have a strong community, help them recover.

label.zh: 驱逐该地居民并将该片区域夷为平地。
label.en: Throw out the inhabitants and raze the area.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[Root.GetName]上的殖民地进行的例行生态研究中，偶然发现了一种奇怪的真菌生命形式。科学小组报告说，菌丝体的表面闪闪发光，色彩斑斓，但最让他们感兴趣的是，每当大范围内发生某些事情时，不同的蘑菇群似乎在相互交流。

此外，生物体的生物特征似乎与殖民地的生态系统明显不同。当地科学团队相当困惑，并要求提供专业支持，因为我们可能正在处理一种有感知力的物种。
descriptions.en:
A routine ecological study of our colony on [Root.GetName] has stumbled upon a strange fungal lifeform. The science team reports that the surface of the mycelium is shimmering and colorful, but what was most intriguing to them was the fact that separate clusters were seemingly communicating with one another whenever something occurred within a wide radius.

Furthermore, the biology of the organism appears to be clearly alien to the ecosystem of the colony. Puzzled, the local science team has requested specialized support as we might be dealing with a sentient species.

label.en: ... They are related to the Fumongus!

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了来自[Root.GetName]的报告。经过进一步检查，我们发现的外星真菌似乎正在向我们目前无法确定的星系中的某个位置发出信号。遥感探测和安全分析表明，菌丝体完全有可能是某种高级间谍生物。

然而，值得注意的是，这种生物体已经想当老了。设计这些间谍蘑菇的人很可能已经不在了。但如果他们还在的话，最好不要唤醒这些沉睡的捕食者。
descriptions.en:
We have concerning reports coming from [Root.GetName]. Upon further examination, it seems that the alien fungus we found is emitting a signal towards a location in the galaxy that we were unable to pinpoint so far. Telemetry and security analysis indicate that it is completely possible for the mycelium to be some kind of advanced spying organism.

However, it is worth noting that this organism is old. There is a fair chance that whomever engineered these spying mushrooms is not around anymore. But if they are, it might be best not to poke the sleeping predator.

label.en: This is too risky. Destroy them.

descriptions.zh:
对菌丝体和信号的仔细分析表明，它可能是类似生物网络的一部分，可能跨越整个星系，甚至更远。虽然我们知道的不多，但我们发现，作为网络的一部分，这个菌丝体也在接收来自其他地方的信号。

我们无法确定，但考虑到包括传输的数据量在内的几个因素，我们认为有人正在积极使用网络并从中收集信息。我们已经在制定虚假信息的反间谍计划，并且正在全帝国范围内更新安全措施以应对这种形式的间谍活动。
descriptions.en:
Careful analysis of the mycelium and the signals showed that it was likely part of a network of similar organisms, possibly spanning across the galaxy as a whole, and maybe beyond. While we do not know much, we discovered that as part of the network, this mycelium was also receiving signals from other places.

We cannot be certain, but considering several factors, including the volume of data transferred, we believe that someone is actively using the network and collecting information from it. We are already working on a counter-intelligence plan of disinformation, and security measures are being updated empire wide to account for this form of spycraft.

descriptions.zh:
对菌丝体和信号的仔细分析表明，它可能是类似生物网络的一部分，可能跨越整个星系，甚至更远。虽然我们知道的不多，但我们发现，作为网络的一部分，这个菌丝体也在接收来自其他地方的信号。

考虑到包括传输的数据量在内的几个因素，我们认为该网络并没有仍在使用中。它仍然部分活跃的事实表明它可能只是处于休眠状态而不是损坏状态。
descriptions.en:
Careful analysis of the mycelium and the signals showed that it was likely part of a network of similar organisms, possibly spanning across the galaxy as a whole, and maybe beyond. While we do not know much, we discovered that as part of the network, this mycelium was also receiving signals from other places.

Considering several factors, including the volume of data transferred, we do not think that the network is still in use. The fact that it is still partially active indicates that it is probably just dormant and not destroyed.

label.en: What can we learn from it?

descriptions.zh: 我们对这种真菌与菌丝体监听阵列的联系的所有疑虑，在经过简短的比较后很快就被打消了。这是与巨大蘑菇交流的众多后代之一，这可能是我们进一步了解这个生物体的好机会。
descriptions.en: Whatever doubts we had about this fungus' connection to the mycelial listening array were quickly dispelled after a brief comparison. This is one of the many offsprings communicating with the Fumongus, and this could be an opportunity to further our comprehension of the organism.

label.zh: 试试我们能否增强这个网络。
label.en: See if we can strengthen the network.
Use it to keep a closer eye on the colony.

label.zh: 拆解这个网络，但我们还是可以研究它。
label.en: We dismantled the network, but we can still study it.

descriptions.zh:
关于我们使用当地菌丝体密切监测菌落的项目的消息已经传播开来，但并没有受到好评。尽管我们尽最大努力来缓和局势，但当地民众普遍认为这是违背相互信任的原则的，并要求我们立即终止该项目。

局势迅速升级，我们当地的执法人员不堪重负。如果我们选择继续这个项目，他们就需要我们的帮助来维持对殖民地的控制。
descriptions.en:
Word about our project to use the local mycelium to closely monitor the colony has spread, and it wasn't well received. Despite our best efforts to defuse the situation, the local population widely considers this as a breach of trust and are demanding that we put an end to this project immediately.

The situation is escalating quickly, and our local enforcers are overwhelmed. They would need help to maintain control of the colony if we choose to go on with the project.

descriptions.zh:
我们在 [Root.GetName] 上培养了菌丝体，并微调了本地计算设备以排除干扰。负责团队报告说，该网络现在正在密切监视殖民者。一些小罪犯已经受到了相应的制裁。

不幸的是，在其他地方复制安装的尝试都失败了。很可能是一些我们尚未知晓的因素在起作用。
descriptions.en:
We have grown the mycelium on [Root.GetName], and fine-tuned the local computing equipment to sort through the interference. The responsible team reports that the network is now closely monitoring the colonists. Already, a number of petty criminals have been sanctioned appropriately.

Unfortunately, attempts at replicating the installation in other places have met with failure. It is likely that some unknown factor is at play here.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们为促进菌丝体在[Root.GetName]上传播所做的努力导致了更多“传统”蘑菇的生长。一些殖民者的事件表明它们是可食用的。此事件使整个网络在一段时间内失去平衡，但现在它似乎稳定且正常运行。然而，整体上并没有明显的改善。看起来这些蘑菇只是用来储存水的。它们对网络没有贡献，它们的破坏也不会对网络产生影响。
descriptions.en: Our efforts to stimulate the spread of the mycelium on [Root.GetName] have resulted in the growth of more 'traditional' mushrooms. An incident with some colonists has shown them to be edible. This event has thrown the whole network off balance for a while, but it now appears to be stabilized and functional. However, no significant improvement has been noticed overall. It looks like these mushrooms are merely storage for water. They do not contribute to the network and their destruction has no impact on it either.
